categories.description: Covers methods and models that learn compressed, abstract representations of environments or dynamics, including VAEs, diffusion models, and discrete token-based latent spaces.
Focuses on techniques for generating diverse, structured, or infinite content (e.g., levels, scenes, narratives) within world models, often using generative priors or rule-based systems.
Encompasses internal dynamics models that simulate future states, enable trajectory prediction, support decision-making, and facilitate planning under uncertainty.
Includes standardized datasets, tasks, and quantitative/qualitative metrics used to assess the fidelity, generalization, and utility of world models.
Addresses frameworks allowing user intervention, steering, or conditioning during generation, enabling real-time interaction and control over simulated worlds.
